kv6.7:1.3: rūpaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ rūpadhātu nīlaṃ pītakaṃ lohitakaṃ odātakaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ cakkhusmiṃ paṭihaññati cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchatī’ti.
kv6.7:3.9: ‘hañci cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇanti’
kv6.7:3.10: atthe’va suttanto, no ca vata re vattabbe.
